Game Overview

Infinity is a animal title where soar as a nimble bird in Infinity, dodging perilous red apples while snatching golden ones to climb the leaderboard. Unleash your reflexes and precision as you navigate this addictive arcade game, set against vibrant skies, challenging you with its dynamic and ever-changing fruit patterns.
